bio: Dr. Ajoy Kapat received his B.Sc. (Honours) in Chemistry from the University of Calcutta and his M.Sc. in Chemistry from the Indian Institute of Technology Madras. He subsequently earned his Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry from the University of Bern, Switzerland, in 2011. Following his doctoral studies, he pursued postdoctoral research at Princeton University, USA, and later at RWTH Aachen University, Germany, where he further strengthened his expertise in modern synthetic organic chemistry and catalysis.

In 2019, Dr. Kapat embarked on his independent academic career as an Assistant Professor in the Department of Chemistry, School of Natural Sciences, Shiv Nadar Institution of Eminence (formerly Shiv Nadar University). His research programme focuses on the development of innovative catalytic methodologies, with particular emphasis on asymmetric catalysis, cascade transformations, and metalloradical catalysis. Through the integration of mechanistic insights and synthetic strategy, his group seeks to advance sustainable and efficient approaches for the construction of structurally complex and biologically relevant molecules, addressing contemporary challenges in organic synthesis and catalysis.
